content.value: Gasoline $( \rho = 6 8 0 \mathrm { k g } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 3 } )$ is pumped through a smooth uniform diameter pipe of 10 (10) km long, at a velocity of 2 m/s. The inlet is equipped with a pump, creating 25 atm pressure (absolute). The exit is at standard atmospheric pressure and is 160 m higher than inlet. Estimate the frictional head loss.
